entries.note: NEW finding for TASK-4: download is REST GET /api/custom-fonts/<id>/download, not GraphQL. Server-side content-disposition filename is a server-generated UUID (1df707cc-....ttf), NOT the font's display name or master filename. However Playwright's download event reported the saved file as 'Hey Magnolia.ttf' (matches the ORIGINAL upload filename, not the current renamed display name 'QA CTX-20260910-05 Hey Magnolia' and not the server content-disposition UUID either) — the browser/portal JS appears to rename the blob client-side using a remembered original filename. Downloaded artifact saved locally to .playwright-mcp/Hey-Magnolia.ttf (outside run write scope, not copied into runs/), content-length 268844 bytes matches source file size class of Hey Magnolia.ttf test fixture.
